notes: Mire: amphibians and shipboard firefighters. Smooth teal-green skin with a pale belly band down the flanks, a wide flat head with two bulging gold eyes, webbed hands (three fingers and a pale web) and big webbed feet with a waddling stride, and a dripping water-tank backpack (their own rig accessory: red fire-crew bands, blue sight glass, a leaking valve). Head variants: bare, helmet (a fire-crew helmet, tinted, the eyes bulge out under the brim). Outfit mask = tank straps, belt, ankle and wrist straps, helmet shell. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 33x33 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0 and 3 are the contacts; the swing boot (frames 1-2 right, 4-5 left) is lifted

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee.
